items.title: Application of Resonance and Standing Waves (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Application of Resonance and Standing Waves: a main subheading of 14.11 Sharpness of Resonance, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 39-40.

blocks.text: Bohat se devices (aalaat) standing waves (khari lehrein, jin ke nodes aur antinodes apni jagah tike rehte hain) banate aur istemal karte hain, aur un mein resonance kaam karti hai.
Standing waves aur resonance ka talluq kuch experiments (tajurbon) se samjha ja sakta hai, jaise Rubens tube, Chladni plates aur acoustic levitation.

Rubens tube ek lamba metal (dhaat) ka pipe hai jis ke oopar ek line mein holes (soorakh) hote hain aur dono sire band hote hain. Ek sire par chhota speaker ya frequency generator laga hota hai aur doosra sira jalne wali gas ki supply se jura hota hai (Fig. 14.21). Pipe gas se bhar jata hai, gas holes se nikalti hai aur jalaane par flames (shoale) bante hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Rubens tube ko standing wave flame tube ya sirf flame tube bhi kehte hain. Yeh tube mein awaz ki standing waves dikhane wala apparatus (aala) hai, jo German physicist Heinrich Rubens ne 1905 mein banaya (kitab mein naam 'Henrich' chhapa hai).

blocks.alt: Gas ka cylinder aik lambe metal pipe ko gas deta hai jis ke oopar holes hain. Doosra sira membrane se band hai aur us ke paar loudspeaker hai. Pipe ke andar standing wave bani hai, aur oopar flames antinodes par oonche aur nodes par neeche hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.21: Rubens tube ka apparatus (aala) (kitab ki Figure 14.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flames wahan oonche hain jahan tube ke andar pressure sab se zyada badalta hai, yani pressure antinodes par, aur nodes par neeche. Do oonche flames ka distance aadhi wavelength hai. Kitab ki figure mein oonche flames sirf wave ki crest (choti) ke oopar hain, jab ke crest aur trough (gehrai) dono antinodes hain; khaake mein dono jagah oonche flames hain.

Jab frequency generator resonance frequency ki awaz paida karta hai to tube ke andar standing wave ban jati hai. Is se tube mein kuch jagah pressure zyada aur kuch jagah kam hota hai. Jahan pressure kam hai wahan holes se kam gas nikalti hai aur flame neecha hota hai; jahan pressure zyada hai wahan holes se zyada gas nikalti hai aur flame ooncha hota hai.
Yeh neeche aur oonche flames tube ke andar standing wave ke nodes aur antinodes dikha dete hain (Fig. 14.21).
